item.title: Russian Bombing Kills 24 at Ukrainian Aid Centre; Kyiv Says Attack Shows No Desire for De-escalation
item.description: At least 24 people were killed and five injured after Russian aerial bombs struck an aid distribution centre in the village of Komyshuvakha in Ukraine's southern Zaporizhzhia region, Ukrainian officials said on Monday. item.title: China Rolls Out Support Measures to Stabilize Struggling Stock Market
item.description: China moved to prop up its struggling equity market, rolling out a set of support measures and convening a regulator meeting aimed at shoring up stocks, according to reports from Bloomberg, Reuters and Barron's.
